review_method: Coordinator read the exact A/B/S differences, current readings and existing intervention rationales for L1-0031–0060. L1-0001–0002 use the two locus bodies already inspected before the blocked batch request. No new source-image decipherment performed. The blocked L1-0003–0030 review is not credited.

L1-0001.rationale: Retain the source-specific Adzom opening, title and invocation scaffold, including the title material not present in the shorter B/S transcript openings. The divergent foreign-script stacks and the invocation are not regularized to either comparison transcript or to reconstructed Sanskrit. Existing title uncertainties remain visible; v1 does not certify those letters.

L1-0002.rationale: Retain Adzom thos in U00012 rather than substituting the B/S bstan reading. Keep U00011 as a structural heading, not a newly added verse. The B transcript lacks that heading and S changes its boundary presentation; those facts do not authorize deleting the source heading or merging it into the root. Caption S08 remains separate and provisional.

L1-0031.rationale: At U00518 the recorded difference is a B-only tsheg. Retain the current Adzom terminal representation; the lexical phrase is not changed. The extra dot is quoted as transcript punctuation, not evidence of a missing Adzom syllable.

L1-0032.rationale: Retain U00520 with dul bai zhing. B inserts mdo before zhing, whereas A/S do not. No adopted Adzom scan correction supplies that extra syllable, so it stays a B transcript addition in the apparatus rather than entering the root.

L1-0033.rationale: Accept the already recorded U00534 source-layer separation: main ljongs rab tu rdzogs te nyams dga bar remains, and bde yang byung is preserved as a smaller linked annotation. S braces do not change that physical disposition. The later Dzongsar role question is witness-specific and does not replace the Adzom decision.

L1-0034.rationale: At U00538 retain the Adzom written pa o division. S omits the recorded intervening tsheg; this is not a reason to conflate the source spelling in the diplomatic reading. No lexical emendation is accepted.

L1-0035.rationale: At U00579 retain the current reading and distinguish its initial spacing from the B/S shad in the exact difference layer. Do not add a detached mark by counting transcript votes; unverified physical punctuation stays qualified.

L1-0036.rationale: Accept the existing U00594 two-shad boundary correction supported by its independent native-context review. The S transcript also supplies a shad, but the adoption rests on the scan record, not S agreement. The root wording is unchanged.

L1-0037.rationale: At U00596 retain main klu yi gdong and preserve glu yang gdung yang byung separately under the accepted smaller-note record. S braces identify a transcript presentation difference; neither alternate word is silently substituted into the main verse.

L1-0038.rationale: Keep U00598 as the sixth reply heading, followed by U00599. The S-only braces are not root characters and do not justify deleting the heading or joining its wording to the following verse; current boundary transcription remains qualified.

L1-0039.rationale: Retain the seventh reply heading U00624 and the accepted U00626 main gzhon pa dang. Keep gzhog kyang in the separate annotation, not in the verse. B lacks that note and S brackets it; these witness presentations do not erase the Adzom source-layer evidence.

L1-0040.rationale: Accept separation of ni yang from U00632 while retaining the main negative ma dag pa yis ye shes so. Do not import B-only gnod kyang into U00633. The two comparison phenomena are distinct: an accepted Adzom note separation and an unadopted B transcript addition.

L1-0041.rationale: The U00635 difference is an internal space retained in A but absent from B/S. Preserve the exact ledger space and the current single-shad boundary after gcig; do not change letters or infer a new sign from the gap.

L1-0042.rationale: Accept the U00651 main gnas dang byung dang byed pa dang and retain byas kyang dug as the displaced small annotation. B omits that annotation and S brackets it. The alternative byas does not replace gnas in the Adzom main text.

L1-0043.rationale: Keep U00655 as the eighth reply heading preceding U00656. The recorded S braces are presentation evidence only; the heading remains explicitly distinguished from root verse.

L1-0044.rationale: At U00658 do not import B-only skyan kyang dug ahead of the nam zla clause. Preserve that addition exactly in B, with no claim that its exemplar has a new main verse. Current Adzom wording remains the v1 reading.

L1-0045.rationale: Keep the ninth reply label U00676 separate from the leu clause U00677. S braces are not transcribed as Adzom text; no new punctuation or lexical correction follows from them.

L1-0046.rationale: At U00694 retain the current Adzom terminal shads. B lacks the recorded shad present in A/S; this is preserved as a transcript-level difference and does not establish that the printed B witness has the same omission.

L1-0047.rationale: Keep U00701 as the tenth reply heading, followed by U00702. The S-only bracketing changes presentation, not the adopted words or their heading role.

L1-0048.rationale: Accept the recorded U00710 main nus pas bsgyur ba gang and the separate bus pa sbyar yang byung annotation. B leaves byung before bsgyur, but that residual interleaving is not adopted. Retain the independently supported tsheg after gang and its two shads; later Dzongsar note-letter uncertainty does not negate the Adzom layer decision.

L1-0049.rationale: Keep U00721 as the eleventh reply heading preceding U00722. Record S braces without introducing them into the selected Adzom text or treating the heading as a newly restored main verse.

L1-0050.rationale: At U00742 retain sde with its single e-vowel mark. B has a duplicated combining e in the exact supplied string. The duplicate is preserved in the apparatus, not copied into the release reading or claimed to be a printed-witness error.

L1-0051.rationale: Retain the U00754–U00757 sequence and distinguish the twelfth reply label U00756 as a heading. The differing spaces and S braces are recorded exactly; they do not justify changing the surrounding main wording or normalizing all shad spacing.

L1-0052.rationale: At U00800 accept the existing main bha ra bha ti sa li sequence and separate sa yi yang byung as the linked smaller annotation. B/S add an i-vowel to ra; do not regularize this Sanskrit-like source spelling to ri merely because two transcripts agree.

L1-0053.rationale: At U00806 retain lo stong bar. B additionally writes stong lo before lo stong and changes bar to par. Preserve both B differences in full; do not expand Adzom or explain the repetition as a historical copying error without evidence.

L1-0054.rationale: Keep U00822 as the thirteenth reply heading followed by the main U00823 clause. The S-only braces are a transcript editorial convention and do not alter the v1 reading.

L1-0055.rationale: Accept the verified two detached shads at the U00910 heading/main boundary, excluding the pa limb. Preserve the fourteenth reply heading and record S bracketing separately; no generic double-shad normalization is performed.

L1-0056.rationale: At U00940 retain Adzom sku r thim nas rather than B kun du gnas. This is a genuine wording divergence in the transcripts, not just spacing. The diplomatic base policy retains the recorded Adzom wording without declaring it the reconstructed original or rewriting it from doctrinal expectations.

L1-0057.rationale: Accept the existing two-mark U00948 boundary correction, retaining the fifteenth reply heading. S braces remain apparatus presentation; the final letter limb is not counted as a third sign.

L1-0058.rationale: Accept the U00995 two-shad correction after the earlier three-mark overcount was rejected. Retain so at the opening of U00996: B lacks that syllable but no Adzom correction removes it. Boundary-sign adoption and the following lexical difference are not conflated.

L1-0059.rationale: At U01001 retain khyim bdag rigs with its current closing marks. B lacks rigs and differs in terminal spacing/punctuation. Preserve the shorter B transcript but do not remove the Adzom word or infer manuscript omission from that transcript alone.

L1-0060.rationale: Accept the verified U01023 two-shad boundary and keep the sixteenth reply heading before U01024. Retain S braces and spacing as apparatus differences, without replacing the existing U01024 punctuation by a normalized style.
